title: A Letter for the Alibi
author: Noor Blackwood
blurb: Isandro Sandoval, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
